meetings.title: Benchmark customization review
meetings.summary: Portfolio review with Linda Larsson covering a benchmark customization for the Capital Group Multi-Sector Income allocation. Agreed the customized benchmark better reflects Westhaven's liability profile.

decisions.text: Adopt the customized benchmark for the Multi-Sector Income allocation.

action_items.text: Coordinate funding paperwork for the benchmark change

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Linda Larsson
transcript_excerpt.text: The customized benchmark lines up much better with our liabilities.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Tom Brennan
transcript_excerpt.text: Agreed - I'll start the funding paperwork to make it official.
